name: Devil Square
note: The world's manifest (docs/plans/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by tools/sync.sh.

rules.note: Devil Square, MU's map 9: four arenas on one terrain, one a square. Square 1's arrival gate 58, 133,91 to 141,99, in the middle of arena A (OpenMU Version095d Gates.cs:141; docs/worlds/devil-square-port.md). Not 0.75's: OpenMU first has it at 0.95d. MU draws it on its black clear and fog, so it takes the underground's air until its rain. Its town is Noria: a death, a Town Portal and the end of the event all land there (WebZen gate 27). The firecracker falls here (sim/items.h firecrackerMap): a kill of level 17 or over, one in 300 (the user, 2026-10-02: 'only from dungeons like dungeon, lost-tower, bc, and devil square', then 'lets do 1 of 300 to all dungeons'). Ours: MU's was any map under Atlans while its event ran.

indoors.note: No open sky on any tile (MU draws it on its black clear, SceneManager.cpp:402).

exits.note: Devil Square 1's, OpenMU 0.95d Gates.cs:141: the arena's box, with no direction. Reached only through Charon (sim/square.h).

grass.note: Devil Square ships no TileGrass .OZT (ZzzLodTerrain.cpp:2081-2088), and its TileGrass01, on every tile, is the arenas' worn stone. docs/worlds/devil-square-port.md.
